nodes.label: Pipeline PL-04 (Synthetic Fixture)
nodes.rationale: Placed ~1.5 km from OS-003's drift origin so the pipeline-proximity check fires within default TRIAGE_PIPELINE_RADIUS_KM=2.0.

nodes.label: Platform P-17 (Synthetic Fixture)
nodes.rationale: Placed ~1.7 km from OS-002's drift origin so the platform-proximity check fires within default TRIAGE_PLATFORM_RADIUS_KM=5.0.

nodes.label: TriageHypothesis Enum
nodes.rationale: Exactly 5 values: likely-vessel, likely-platform, likely-pipeline, possible-natural-seep, insufficient-evidence. possible-natural-seep is never emitted by the current engine (seep detection is STRETCH) but stays frozen in the contract.

nodes.label: VesselFeatures
nodes.rationale: Currently carries only proximity and trajectory_alignment (0-100); dark-gap, behavioural, integrity features not yet in this contract.

nodes.label: Candidate Vessel (Vocabulary)
nodes.rationale: AIS track that survived space-time filtering against the origin window and is therefore eligible for scoring.

nodes.label: Case Artifact (Vocabulary)
nodes.rationale: Serialized, precomputed result of running the full pipeline over one case, stored so the demo never depends on live computation.

nodes.label: Confidence Tier (Vocabulary)
nodes.rationale: Coarse High/Medium/Low banding of a suspicion score, introduced Stage 36.

nodes.label: Dossier (Vocabulary)
nodes.rationale: Auto-generated investigator's report compiling detection record, source hypothesis, origin estimate, forecast track, and suspect list — output of scope Stage E.

nodes.label: Feature Score (Vocabulary)
nodes.rationale: One named, individually visible component of evidence about a candidate vessel — proximity, trajectory alignment, dark-gap, behavioral anomaly, track integrity, historical base rate — each independently inspectable through to the dossier.

nodes.label: Interface Contract (Vocabulary)
nodes.rationale: Frozen, written specification of coordinate system, timestamp format, spill-polygon schema, and every inter-stage payload shape; defined in Stage 1.

nodes.label: Origin Estimate (Vocabulary)
nodes.rationale: Complete output of the hindcast: origin point, origin time window, spatial tolerance. Most widely consumed object in Part III.

nodes.label: Origin Probability Field / Probability Cone (Vocabulary)
nodes.rationale: WORTH ADDING ensemble product: spatial probability distribution over possible origins aggregated from perturbed simulations, rendered as a probability cone.

nodes.label: Positioning Statement (Vocabulary)
nodes.rationale: Verbatim decision-support disclaimer: investigative leads for human review, not automated legal determinations. Required verbatim in every dossier.

nodes.label: Source Hypothesis (Vocabulary)
nodes.rationale: Output of scope Stage B: label from {likely-vessel, likely-platform, likely-pipeline, possible-natural-seep, insufficient-evidence} with confidence and evidence.

nodes.label: Spill Polygon (Vocabulary)
nodes.rationale: Vectorized geographic boundary of the detected oil-spill region, WGS84, GeoJSON; most widely shared object in the system, schema frozen in Stage 1.

nodes.label: Stage 1 — Interface Contract Freeze
nodes.rationale: Untagged in source; the precondition for every MVP feature being buildable in parallel. Fixes CRS (WGS84/EPSG:4326, lon-first GeoJSON), ISO8601 UTC timestamps, spill polygon schema, detection/origin/hypothesis/suspect-list schemas, units, and identity. Root of the dependency graph, no upstream stage. Silent failure mode: coordinate order transposition producing a schema-valid but wrong-hemisphere spill.

nodes.label: Stage 2 — Demo Case Curation & Ground-Truth Anchor Selection
nodes.norm_label: stage 2 — demo case curation & ground-truth anchor selection
nodes.rationale: [MVP]. Selects 2-3 curated cases; one is the ground-truth anchor, a real ITOPF/NOAA-ERMA-documented spill with known origin used by Stage 21 to compute the project's one quantified drift-accuracy number. Risk: the anchor's 'documented origin' may itself be an estimate, not a surveyed fact.

nodes.label: Stage 3 — SAR Corpus Acquisition & Preprocessing
nodes.rationale: [MVP]. Acquires public 5-class SAR Oil Spill dataset (official train/test split preserved) plus per-case scenes; preprocessing must retain georeferencing metadata or Stage 7 cannot place a polygon on Earth.

nodes.label: Stage 4 — Forcing-Data Acquisition & Regional Caching
nodes.rationale: [MVP]. Caches ocean current (NOAA OSCAR/HYCOM/Copernicus) and wind (ECMWF ERA5/NOAA GFS) fields per case region/window, extending backward past hindcast horizon and forward past forecast horizon. Access-approval gates are a named Risk Register item; mitigation is registering and caching early.

nodes.label: Stage 5 — Static Geospatial Reference Layer
nodes.rationale: [MVP] with [STRETCH] seep extension. Coastline, sensitive zones, platforms (Global Energy Monitor/OSM), pipelines (OSM); hand-verified static fallback when public coverage is thin. Entire evidential basis for multi-hypothesis triage — an empty dataset silently makes every case report likely-vessel.

nodes.label: Stage 6 — Multi-Class SAR Segmentation Model
nodes.rationale: [MVP]. U-Net-family CNN classifying every pixel as oil-spill/look-alike/land/ship/sea-surface; the 5-class scheme is what makes look-alike confidence extractable in Stage 8 without a separate classifier. Risk: severe class imbalance where oil-spill/look-alike collapse into sea-surface while aggregate accuracy stays high.

nodes.label: Stage 7 — Inference & Mask-to-Polygon Vectorization
nodes.rationale: [MVP]. Converts detection mask into a georeferenced GeoJSON spill polygon; the single point where a pixel-space error becomes a geographic error. Decisions here (MultiPolygon vs separate detections, min-area threshold, simplification) are contract decisions.

nodes.label: Stage 8 — Look-Alike Confidence Extraction & Propagation
nodes.rationale: [MVP]. Extracts a per-detection confidence from the model's own class probabilities and establishes the discipline that it is propagated everywhere as 'indicative, uncalibrated', never a precise statistical percentage. First and most visible instance of the uncertainty-awareness differentiator.

nodes.label: Stage 9 — Geometric Property Extraction
nodes.rationale: [MVP]. Area, perimeter, elongation, centroid, coastline distance; area must be computed in a projected CRS, not degrees. Elongation is corroborating triage evidence: elongated=moving source, compact=stationary source.

nodes.label: Stage 10 — Detection Evaluation Harness
nodes.rationale: Untagged in source. Rerunnable IoU/Dice per class and mean on the official held-out split; per-class reporting is load-bearing because the mean is dominated by easy abundant classes.

nodes.label: Stage 11 — Historical Benchmark Validation of the Detector
nodes.norm_label: stage 11 — historical benchmark validation of the detector
nodes.rationale: [WORTH ADDING]. Runs the frozen detector, unchanged, over real historical incidents (ITOPF/NOAA ERMA) to report a hit rate — closes the gap between test-split performance and real-world usefulness.

nodes.label: Stage 12 — Indicative Age Estimation
nodes.rationale: [STRETCH]. Fay's-model-style spreading physics infers a rough age range from area/shape, reported only as an approximation, never a precise figure; independently corroborates the Stage 14 origin time window.

nodes.label: Stage 13 — Drift Engine Integration
nodes.rationale: [MVP], explicitly 'a working-engine decision, not a stretch feature.' Stands up OpenDrift's OpenOil module (chosen over generic OceanDrift for its built-in weathering interface, which Stage 17 later uses). Most dangerous silent failure in Part III: engine running on default/fallback forcing rather than the cached case data, producing a smooth plausible trajectory encoding no real oceanography.

nodes.label: Stage 14 — Backward Hindcast & Origin Estimate
nodes.rationale: [MVP]. Runs the engine backward from the spill polygon to produce the origin estimate (point, time window, tolerance) — the hinge of the entire investigation, consumed by triage and all of attribution. Silent failure: a physically implausible origin (on land, unrealistic implied drift speed) flowing downstream with full confidence.

nodes.label: Stage 15 — Forward Forecast & Predicted Spread
nodes.rationale: [MVP]. Same engine run forward from the same seeding to produce a time-indexed forecast track over hours to days — the only part of the system that is operationally actionable for a response analyst. Independent of Stage 14, shares seeding code.

nodes.label: Stage 16 — Landfall & Sensitive-Zone Timing Metric
nodes.rationale: [MVP]. Scans forecast track for first centroid crossing of coastline/sensitive-zone boundary; no-crossing-within-horizon must be an explicit distinguishable value, never rendered as a blank or zero (which would read as 'no risk').

nodes.label: Stage 17 — Weathering-Enabled Forward Forecast
nodes.rationale: [WORTH ADDING]. Turns on OpenOil's native evaporation/emulsification/dispersion/biodegradation physics — a configuration task rather than new modelling specifically because Stage 13 chose OpenOil over the generic module.

nodes.label: Stage 18 — Perturbed Ensemble Execution
nodes.rationale: [WORTH ADDING], named 'the single biggest technical/logistics risk in the project.' Runs 100+ perturbed simulations per direction with correlated (not independent per-timestep) error to produce a real spread; the guaranteed MVP baseline is Stage 14/15's single deterministic run if this is dropped.

nodes.label: Stage 19 — Origin Probability Field & Cone Aggregation
nodes.norm_label: stage 19 — origin probability field & cone aggregation
nodes.rationale: [WORTH ADDING]. Reduces ensemble trajectories to a spatial probability distribution (the probability cone) with stated containment levels, gridded no finer than forcing resolution supports; represents uncertainty only from applied perturbations, a lower bound on true uncertainty.

nodes.label: Stage 20 — Hand-Rolled Advection Cross-Check
nodes.rationale: [STRETCH]. ~100-200 line independent bilinear-interpolation advection routine, reading forcing fields directly rather than through the engine's readers, cross-checked against OpenDrift output — the independent check on Stage 13's default-forcing failure mode.

nodes.label: Stage 21 — Drift Accuracy Evaluation Against the Ground-Truth Anchor
nodes.norm_label: stage 21 — drift accuracy evaluation against the ground-truth anchor
nodes.rationale: [MVP, required]. Reports distance error (km) and time error (hours) against the anchor's documented origin, with n=1 caveat attached to the number itself; plus a calibration fraction if the ensemble exists. This number 'must appear in the evaluation slide regardless of what else gets built.'

nodes.label: Stage 22 — Origin Proximity Testing Against Fixed Infrastructure
nodes.norm_label: stage 22 — origin proximity testing against fixed infrastructure
nodes.rationale: [MVP]. Tests the origin window against Stage 5's platform/pipeline reference layer; radius must be calibrated against Stage 14's own spatial tolerance. Absence of a match is weak evidence of absence because dataset coverage may be incomplete.

nodes.label: Stage 23 — Source Hypothesis Labelling & the Routing Gate
nodes.norm_label: stage 23 — source hypothesis labelling & the routing gate
nodes.rationale: [MVP]. The narrowest, most consequential logic in the pipeline: only likely-vessel and insufficient-evidence (flagged low-confidence) proceed into Stage D; likely-platform/likely-pipeline/possible-natural-seep go straight to the dossier. Tested directly by Stage 37's false-implication check.

nodes.label: Stage 24 — Natural Seep Zone Check
nodes.rationale: [STRETCH]. Same geometric test as Stage 22 against a seep-zone dataset, feeding the possible-natural-seep label; a SAR detector cannot distinguish seep oil from discharged oil by appearance, so location is the only discriminator.

nodes.label: Stage 25 — Repeated-Origin Pattern Detection
nodes.rationale: [STRETCH]. Several spills independently tracing to the same fixed coordinates is strong evidence of a stationary source, since a moving vessel would not produce that pattern — can find undocumented stationary sources that appear in no infrastructure dataset. Risk: shared systematic hindcast bias mimics a real cluster.

nodes.label: Stage 26 — AIS Schema Study & Canonical Track Representation
nodes.norm_label: stage 26 — ais schema study & canonical track representation
nodes.rationale: [MVP]. Studies real public AIS sample data to define the canonical track schema used throughout Part V; real sample data used only to match format/structure, demo tracks are synthetically generated.

nodes.label: Stage 27 — Synthetic AIS Scenario Generator
nodes.rationale: [MVP]. Generates background traffic plus planted guilty vessel(s) per scenario (30-50 scenarios for Stage 37), including negative non-vessel-source scenarios with no guilty vessel. It is simultaneously the demo's data source and the ground truth for every attribution metric — the single most important disclosed limitation in Part V.

nodes.label: Stage 28 — Space-Time Candidate Filtering
nodes.rationale: [MVP]. Retains only AIS tracks intersecting the origin window in space AND time (genuine intersection, not two independent tests); a track is excluded only if entirely outside the window — filter is deliberately generous since false exclusion is unrecoverable.

nodes.label: Stage 29 — Proximity Feature Score
nodes.rationale: [MVP]. Normalized spatial+temporal closeness score to the origin window. Most vulnerable feature to a vessel going dark on AIS before discharging — the direct mitigation is Stage 33's dark-gap feature.

nodes.label: Stage 30 — Trajectory Alignment Feature Score
nodes.rationale: [MVP]. Scores how well a vessel's course aligns with the backward drift PATH (not just the origin endpoint), so requires Stage 14 retain the full trajectory. Discriminating power drops in busy shipping lanes where vessels share a course by definition.

nodes.label: Stage 31 — Baseline Weighted Scorer & Ranked Suspect List
nodes.norm_label: stage 31 — baseline weighted scorer & ranked suspect list
nodes.rationale: [MVP]. Transparent weighted sum of proximity+trajectory feature scores producing the ranked suspect list; scope document explicitly forbids describing it as 'Bayesian belief propagation' or anything more advanced than it actually is. Feature scores travel with the total, never discarded after summing.

nodes.label: Stage 32 — Track Integrity Layer & Implausible-Track Injection
nodes.norm_label: stage 32 — track integrity layer & implausible-track injection
nodes.rationale: [WORTH ADDING]. Injects deliberately implausible tracks (impossible speed/acceleration, teleporting positions) and builds a rule-based checker producing a per-track integrity score used as a down-weighting modifier, not a peer feature — a demonstrable answer to 'your data is synthetic, how do you know this works.'

nodes.label: Stage 33 — Dark-Gap Feature & Dead-Reckoning Interpolation
nodes.rationale: [WORTH ADDING]. Detects AIS transmission gaps, scores by duration/location/reappearance-near-origin, and current-consistent dead-reckons a plausible position during the gap — the direct mitigation for the MVP scorer's known vulnerability to a vessel going dark before discharging. Most consequential misrepresentation risk in the whole system: an interpolated position shown with the same visual weight as a reported one.

nodes.label: Stage 34 — Behavioral Fingerprinting & Self-Anomaly Score
nodes.rationale: [WORTH ADDING]. Scores deviation from a vessel's OWN historical behavioural pattern, independent of the drift model entirely, so it is robust to hindcast error corrupting proximity/trajectory together. Requires extending Stage 27's generator with per-vessel histories.

nodes.label: Stage 35 — Historical Base-Rate Prior
nodes.rationale: [STRETCH]. A minor, region-level prior from historical incident density reused from Stage 11's sourcing; weighted small enough that it cannot reorder the ranking on its own, since heavy weighting would rank vessels partly on geography rather than behavior — a fairness risk.

nodes.label: Stage 36 — Extended Scorer, Confidence Tiers & Evidence Breakdown
nodes.norm_label: stage 36 — extended scorer, confidence tiers & evidence breakdown
nodes.rationale: [WORTH ADDING]. Combines all 6 feature scores, treats integrity as a down-weighting modifier not a peer term, emits High/Medium/Low confidence tiers weighted conservative toward false negatives over false positives given the real-world cost of wrongly accusing a vessel. Completes the explainable-attribution differentiator.

nodes.label: Stage 37 — Attribution Evaluation Harness
nodes.rationale: Untagged in source. Reports Top-1 hit rate, Top-3 hit rate (called 'the single most important number in the whole evaluation'), and the false-implication check (non-vessel-source scenarios must produce no vessel suspect list) — the quantitative evidence for multi-hypothesis triage.

nodes.label: Stage 38 — REST API Surface
nodes.rationale: Untagged in source. Endpoints return contract objects directly, no separate API-model reshaping. Triage gate must be honoured at the boundary: /attribute on a non-vessel case returns an explicit not-applicable response, never an empty suspect list, since the two mean different things.

nodes.label: Stage 39 — End-to-End Orchestration & the Case Artifact Store
nodes.norm_label: stage 39 — end-to-end orchestration & the case artifact store
nodes.rationale: Untagged in source. Runs the full pipeline in dependency order with the conditional Stage-D branch, precomputes contract-conforming, versioned, provenance-stamped case artifacts so the live demo never depends on live computation (esp. the ensemble).

nodes.label: Stage 40 — Dossier Assembly
nodes.rationale: [MVP]. Compiles spill summary, source hypothesis, drift summary, and (vessel-path only) suspect list with synthetic-data disclosure, plus the positioning statement verbatim in every generated report including non-vessel paths. No new modelling — pure templating.

nodes.label: Stage 41 — Full Evidence Breakdown & Alternative Hypotheses
nodes.norm_label: stage 41 — full evidence breakdown & alternative hypotheses
nodes.rationale: [WORTH ADDING]. Presents every feature score per candidate with underlying raw quantities plus explicitly listed alternative-hypothesis vessels, styled like OSINT investigative reports, so the dossier presents an investigation rather than a verdict.

nodes.label: Stage 42 — Polished Dossier Export
nodes.rationale: [WORTH ADDING]. Self-contained polished PDF/document export carrying every disclosure and the verbatim positioning statement, since it is the version most likely to be read without the application's framing around it.

nodes.label: Stage 43 — Map Shell, Sidebar & Wizard State Machine
nodes.norm_label: stage 43 — map shell, sidebar & wizard state machine
nodes.rationale: [MVP]. React useState-based wizard state machine (explicitly no Redux/Zustand) implementing the conditional branch: non-vessel hypothesis skips the AIS step entirely — the same routing gate expressed a third time after Stage 23 and Stage 38.

nodes.label: Stage 44 — Curated Case Selection & Guided Camera Transition
nodes.norm_label: stage 44 — curated case selection & guided camera transition
nodes.rationale: [MVP]. Dropdown of 2-3 curated cases (safer for live demo than arbitrary upload, per Risk Register) plus animated flyTo world-to-region transition as the narrative's opening move.

nodes.label: Stage 45 — Detection Layer & Look-Alike Confidence Display
nodes.norm_label: stage 45 — detection layer & look-alike confidence display
nodes.rationale: [MVP]. Spill polygon and look-alike confidence indicator are bound together in a single MVP requirement so a detection is never shown without simultaneously showing how much to trust it. Confidence indicator must never read as a precise percentage.

nodes.label: Stage 46 — Source-Hypothesis Step & UI Routing Gate
nodes.norm_label: stage 46 — source-hypothesis step & ui routing gate
nodes.rationale: [MVP]. Renders the source hypothesis before any vessel content, positioned deliberately before the AIS step — the multi-hypothesis triage differentiator made visible to a viewer as a sequence rather than a claim in a report.

nodes.label: Stage 47 — AIS Candidate Vessel Layer
nodes.rationale: [MVP]. Renders filtered candidate vessels as static, non-animated points, shown only on a vessel hypothesis — the third expression of the routing gate. Dead-reckoned positions must be visually distinguishable from reported ones.

nodes.label: Stage 48 — Dossier Report View
nodes.rationale: [MVP]. Terminal wizard step rendering Stage 40's dossier in-app; must render identically-complete on both the vessel and non-vessel branch, with no empty placeholder suspects section on the non-vessel path.

nodes.label: Stage 49 — Dual-Mode Attribution / Forecast Drift View
nodes.norm_label: stage 49 — dual-mode attribution / forecast drift view
nodes.rationale: [WORTH ADDING]. Toggle between attribution mode (backward hindcast + probability cone) and forecast mode (forward track + landfall timing), both driven by the same drift engine output — the clearest illustration that drift is the system's spine.

nodes.label: Stage 50 — Suspicion-Tier Visual Encoding
nodes.rationale: [WORTH ADDING]. Encodes vessel points by confidence tier (discrete bands) rather than a continuous score ramp, matching the tiering system's coarse honesty; must match the dossier exactly for the same vessel or it is a contract failure.

nodes.label: Stage 51 — Arbitrary SAR Upload Path
nodes.rationale: [STRETCH]. Runs uploaded imagery through Stage 3/7 preprocessing/inference only, explicitly naming which downstream stages cannot run (no cached forcing, no infrastructure layer, no synthetic AIS for that region). Never the primary demo path per the Risk Register.

nodes.label: Stage 52 — Time-Scrubbed Ensemble Animation
nodes.rationale: [STRETCH]. Time-scrubbing slider animating the time-indexed probability field with vessel positions in sync using deck.gl/kepler.gl; entirely dependent on Stage 19's ensemble existing — cannot be built without it.

nodes.label: Stage 53 — Consolidated Evaluation Section
nodes.rationale: Untagged in source. Assembles detection IoU/Dice, attribution Top-1/Top-3/false-implication, and drift distance/time error with each number's qualifying disclosure sitting adjacent to it, not in a separate caveats slide; attribution numbers are weakest in what they establish yet strongest-looking on a slide.

nodes.label: Stage 54 — Disclosed-Limitations Ledger & Rehearsed Framing
nodes.rationale: Untagged in source. Consolidates all scope-Section-14 limitations mapped to their originating stages plus rehearsed answers (synthetic-AIS answer must cover the whole of Stage D, not one feature) — Risk Register instruction: 'do not let this be discovered live.'

nodes.label: Suspect List (Vocabulary)
nodes.rationale: Ranked list of candidate vessels with suspicion scores and full feature-score breakdowns; output object of scope Stage D.

nodes.label: PRD Stage B Hypothesis Enumeration
nodes.rationale: likely-vessel, likely-platform, likely-pipeline, possible-natural-seep, insufficient-evidence — do not introduce alternative labels.

nodes.label: Infrastructure Data Provenance
nodes.rationale: platforms.geojson and pipelines.geojson are a small hand-verified static dataset with synthetic/placeholder coordinates constructed to make the three demo cases produce their intended Stage B hypothesis; must be replaced before any claim of realism.

nodes.label: Cross-Stage Interface Contracts Overview
nodes.rationale: Frozen contracts document; where doc and backend/app/schemas/ disagree, schemas win and the document is the defect. Real stage order is A -> C -> B -> D -> E, not the PRD's A-E lettering, because triage tests the hindcasted origin from Stage C.

nodes.label: PRD Evaluation Support Requirements
nodes.rationale: Stage A: IoU, Dice, per-class, mean. Stage D: Top-1, Top-3, false implication check. Stage C: origin distance error, origin time error. Do not invent evaluation numbers.

nodes.label: Differentiator: Explainable Attribution
nodes.rationale: Every vessel's score decomposes into named, individually visible evidence components, never a single opaque number.

nodes.label: Differentiator: Multi-Hypothesis Source Triage
nodes.rationale: System considers stationary sources (platforms, pipelines, natural seeps) before ships, so an innocent passing vessel is not force-fitted as culprit.

nodes.label: Differentiator: Narrative UI
nodes.rationale: The investigation is communicated as a guided sequence walking a user through the reasoning, not a static dashboard of panels.

nodes.label: Differentiator: Uncertainty-Awareness
nodes.rationale: The system reports a distribution over possible origins rather than a confident point, and reports detection confidence as indicative rather than truth.

nodes.label: PRD No New ML in Stage B
nodes.norm_label: prd no new ml in stage b
nodes.rationale: Stage B must use geospatial distance, proximity, deterministic rules, infrastructure evidence; no ML classifier without explicit team approval.

nodes.label: PRD No New Modelling in Stage E
nodes.norm_label: prd no new modelling in stage e
nodes.rationale: Stage E must not predict vessel guilt, recalculate drift, run segmentation, modify AIS scores, or create new scientific conclusions.

nodes.label: PRD Stage B Infrastructure Data Sources
nodes.norm_label: prd stage b infrastructure data sources
nodes.rationale: Global Energy Monitor, OpenStreetMap primary; if coverage poor for demo region, use small hand-verified static list; do not allow missing external data to break the demo.

nodes.label: PRD Stage B Routing Rule
nodes.rationale: likely-platform/likely-pipeline/possible-natural-seep -> Stage D must NOT run. likely-vessel -> may run. insufficient-evidence -> low-confidence vessel investigation, clearly labelled.

nodes.label: AttributionResult (Stage D)
nodes.rationale: executed:false with candidates:[] is NOT the same as executed:true with candidates:[]; first means no search performed (triage diverted), second means search ran and found nothing.

nodes.label: Not Yet Frozen — Open Items (§10, 11 items)
nodes.norm_label: not yet frozen — open items (§10, 11 items)
nodes.rationale: Largest gap: DriftResult.uncertainty is dict|None, completely untyped — where the ensemble probability field/cone would go.

nodes.label: docs/decisions.md (Referenced but Missing)
nodes.rationale: Referenced by app/schemas/attribution.py and app/core/config.py as the record for the low_confidence addition and placeholder thresholds, but does not exist in the repo — a dangling doc reference.

nodes.label: Triage Radius Thresholds (Placeholder Values)
nodes.rationale: TRIAGE_PLATFORM_RADIUS_KM=5.0 / TRIAGE_PIPELINE_RADIUS_KM=2.0 are placeholder values pending explicit team sign-off.

nodes.label: PRD Configuration Requirements
nodes.rationale: TRIAGE_PLATFORM_RADIUS_KM, TRIAGE_PIPELINE_RADIUS_KM, TRIAGE_VESSEL_LOW_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD, MAP_DEFAULT_ZOOM, MAP_DEFAULT_CENTER, API_TIMEOUT_SECONDS must not be hardcoded; do not invent final values without team approval.

nodes.label: PRD Responsive Design Target
nodes.rationale: Primary target desktop/laptop for SIH demo; mobile secondary.

nodes.label: PRD Source-Type Triage Before Vessel Attribution
nodes.norm_label: prd source-type triage before vessel attribution
nodes.rationale: A spill must not automatically be attributed to a vessel; Stage D executes only on likely-vessel or intentional low-confidence insufficient-evidence investigation.

nodes.label: PRD Stage B Decision Logic
nodes.rationale: Deterministic explainable rules; no black-box ML classifier; platform > pipeline > vessel > insufficient-evidence conceptual ordering; thresholds must be configuration values.

nodes.label: PRD Stage D Evaluation Disclosure
nodes.rationale: Evaluation validates attribution mechanism against controlled ground truth; does not establish generalization to real, messy AIS data.

nodes.label: PRD Stage E Investigator's Dossier
nodes.rationale: Stage E does NO modelling, is a reporting/presentation layer only.

nodes.label: PRD Success Criteria
nodes.rationale: Core differentiation is not the segmentation model but integration, explainability, multi-hypothesis source triage, uncertainty awareness, investigation-oriented presentation.

nodes.label: PRD Synthetic Data Disclosure
nodes.rationale: 'AIS tracks shown in this demonstration are synthetically generated for controlled validation and do not represent live vessel traffic.' Must appear in attribution UI, final report, and limitations.

nodes.label: PRD System Architecture Diagram
nodes.rationale: Stage A -> Stage B (branch: stationary source vs likely vessel) -> [Stage C -> Stage D] -> Stage E -> FastAPI -> React -> Mapbox.

nodes.label: PRD Time Contract
nodes.rationale: UTC ISO 8601 timestamps everywhere; never ambiguous local timestamps between stages.

nodes.label: PRD Uncertainty Awareness Principle
nodes.rationale: Never present model outputs as absolute truth; use 'Indicative detection confidence' rather than '87% probability this is definitely oil.'

nodes.label: PRD Visual Design Guidance
nodes.rationale: Professional maritime intelligence tool: dark/neutral aesthetic, restrained color, strong map focus, subtle motion; avoid generic Bootstrap look, excessive gradients/neon, dashboard card overload.

nodes.label: CaseMeta
nodes.rationale: OS-001 flagged is_historical_ground_truth:true but named '[PROVISIONAL] Historical Vessel-Source Case' — real ITOPF/NOAA ERMA case not yet selected.

nodes.label: CaseSummary
nodes.rationale: investigation_timestamp and detection_timestamp typed str, not datetime, bypassing §1.2 UTC enforcement.

nodes.label: Changing This Contract — Process (§11)
nodes.rationale: 1) change backend/app/schemas/ first, 2) update fixtures in data/cases/, 3) update this document in the same change, 4) additive-optional changes are safe, anything else needs affected stage owners to know before it lands.

nodes.label: InvestigationReport (Stage E)
nodes.rationale: Reporting layer only, every field filled from an already-computed stage result; Stage E infers nothing and computes nothing new.

nodes.label: Time Contract: UTC-Enforced (§1.2)
nodes.rationale: require_utc() rejects naive datetimes and non-UTC offsets. Exception: CaseSummary.investigation_timestamp/detection_timestamp and CaseMeta.date are typed str, not datetime, so UTC enforcement does not apply to them (open item).

nodes.label: PRD InvestigationReport Data Model
nodes.rationale: PDF generation must consume this structured object rather than independently querying multiple stages.

nodes.label: test_contracts.py Enforcement Suite (12 tests)
nodes.rationale: Checked-in fixtures under data/cases/ validated against live schemas on every run so a breaking schema change fails the suite rather than surfacing later.

nodes.label: DetectionConfidence
nodes.rationale: type is a frozen literal 'indicative_uncalibrated' on purpose so a consumer cannot present it as a calibrated probability.

nodes.label: DISCLAIMER Frozen Literal
nodes.rationale: Typed as Literal['this is a decision-support lead list, not a legal determination.'] so it cannot be silently reworded; any other value fails validation.

nodes.label: Error Envelope Contract (§8.2)
nodes.rationale: {error:{type, message, request_id}}; upstream_contract_error is 502 when a Stage A/C/D response fails schema validation, because fault is upstream not here.

nodes.label: HindcastResult
nodes.rationale: origin and origin_time_window are what Stage B tests against infrastructure and Stage D filters candidate vessels against; path is a separate requirement needed for trajectory-alignment scoring.

nodes.label: HTTP API Surface (§8)
nodes.rationale: /api/report/{case_id} has no body and requires a completed investigation (calls POST /api/investigation/run first) unlike other stage endpoints.

nodes.label: Human Decision Gate Cross-Reference
nodes.rationale: Automated tests do not prove two people read the document the same way; see staged-build-reference.md Stage 1's Human Decision Gate: two people independently hand-encode the same spill and compare field for field.

nodes.label: InfrastructureEvidence
nodes.rationale: distance_km null means no data for the region; nearby:false means data exists but nothing within radius — treating them the same reports a confident vessel hypothesis on an empty dataset.

nodes.label: Numeric Scales Inconsistency (§1.4)
nodes.rationale: DetectionConfidence.value is 0-1; VesselCandidate.score and VesselFeatures are 0-100; TriageConfidence.value is unconstrained. A live inconsistency flagged in §10 open items.

nodes.label: Coordinates and Axis Order (§1.1)
nodes.rationale: Coordinate object {lat, lon} vs GeoJSON [lon, lat] opposite axis order; Coordinate.to_geojson_point() is the single conversion point; a transposed pair produces a schema-valid payload in the wrong hemisphere.

nodes.label: TriageResult (Stage B)
nodes.rationale: Consumes DriftResult.hindcast.origin and produces the routing decision that gates Stage D. Engine in app/services/triage_service.py.

nodes.label: Required vs Required-Nullable vs Optional (§1.5)
nodes.rationale: null means not applicable or not computed, must never be represented as 0, empty string, or empty list. e.g. ForecastResult.time_to_coastline_hours: null means no crossing, not 'arrives immediately.'

nodes.label: SpillGeometry
nodes.rationale: polygon is GeoJSONPolygon, single Polygon not MultiPolygon; centroid not guaranteed to fall inside polygon for crescent/multi-part geometries.

nodes.label: Stage Provider Modes (mock/real)
nodes.rationale: STAGE_A_MODE, STAGE_C_MODE, STAGE_D_MODE default to mock, reading data/cases/{case_id}/*.json; swapping to real must not require schema changes.

nodes.label: TriageConfidence
nodes.rationale: type frozen to 'rule_based' because it is a deterministic rule outcome, not a probability; value field unconstrained (open item).

nodes.label: TriageEvidence
nodes.rationale: narrative field is human-readable evidence lines generated by _build_narrative(), intended for direct display.

nodes.label: TriageRouting (The Gate)
nodes.rationale: run_vessel_attribution true for likely-vessel and insufficient-evidence (low_confidence true); false for likely-platform/likely-pipeline. Decision order in evaluate_triage(): platform wins if within radius and at least as close as pipeline; else pipeline; else vessel if evidence available; else insufficient-evidence.

nodes.label: Canonical Vocabulary (§0.3)
nodes.rationale: Terms defined once so one object does not acquire three different names or three different shapes across a system built by several people in parallel.

nodes.label: Case (Vocabulary)
nodes.rationale: One curated, pre-verified demo scenario: a specific SAR scene over a specific region at a specific time plus everything needed to run the full pipeline over it.

nodes.label: True Dependency Spine (§0.1)
nodes.rationale: Ordering deliberately departs from scope document's A-E lettering: Foundational contracts -> Detection (A) -> Drift backward (C hindcast) -> Source-Type Triage (B) -> AIS Attribution (D, vessel-only) -> Reporting (E) -> Presentation. Triage cannot be built before hindcast because it tests the hindcasted origin against infrastructure.

nodes.label: Detection Record (Vocabulary)
nodes.rationale: Frozen output of scope Stage A: spill polygon, geometric property set, look-alike confidence, detection timestamp, scene identity. Everything downstream consumes this, not raw imagery.

nodes.label: The Four Differentiators (§0.4)
nodes.rationale: Segmentation accuracy is not the project's contribution; the contribution is four properties of the integrated system: uncertainty-awareness, explainable attribution, multi-hypothesis source triage, narrative UI.

nodes.label: Look-Alike Confidence (Vocabulary)
nodes.rationale: Indicative, uncalibrated score of genuine oil spill vs look-alike, derived from segmentation model's own class probabilities; never a precise statistical percentage.

nodes.label: Origin Window (Vocabulary)
nodes.rationale: Space-time extent of the origin estimate; the object AIS tracks are filtered against and triage tests against fixed infrastructure.

nodes.label: Staged Build Reference Overview
nodes.rationale: Execution companion to the locked project scope document (v4); decomposes locked scope into 54 dependency-ordered, self-contained build stages.

nodes.label: Identity Contract: case_id / vessel_id (§1.6)
nodes.rationale: case_id is the join key across all five stages; registry OS-001/OS-002/OS-003 in app/data/demo_cases.py. Vessels identified by vessel_id, fixtures use form MMSI-100001.

nodes.label: InvestigationCase (Aggregate)
nodes.rationale: Every stage result explicitly nullable rather than sentinel-defaulted so frontend can distinguish 'not yet computed' from 'not applicable' from 'zero'.

nodes.label: PRD Data Flow: InvestigationCase
nodes.rationale: InvestigationCase aggregates case metadata, detection, triage, drift, attribution, report, provenance; frontend should consume this aggregate rather than internal stage details.

nodes.label: Suspicion Score (Vocabulary)
nodes.rationale: Single transparent weighted combination of feature scores per vessel; never a black-box output, contributing feature scores travel with it everywhere.

nodes.label: Tier Labels Convention (§0.2)
nodes.rationale: [MVP]/[WORTH ADDING]/[STRETCH] reproduced exactly from scope document as priority labels, never scheduling markers; untagged-in-source stages get no invented tier.

nodes.label: PRD Adapter Pattern
nodes.rationale: DetectionProvider, DriftProvider, AttributionProvider interfaces with Mock/Real implementations enabling parallel development.

nodes.label: PRD API Client Centralization
nodes.rationale: All frontend API calls in services/api.ts with typed methods getCases, getCase, runInvestigation, getInvestigation, runTriage, getDrift, getAttribution, generateReport.

nodes.label: LLM Backend Fallback (Gemini key vs host-agent)
nodes.norm_label: llm backend fallback (gemini key vs host-agent)

nodes.label: SIH Oil Spill Investigation Pipeline Mission
nodes.norm_label: sih oil spill investigation pipeline mission

nodes.label: Stage D: AIS Correlation & Vessel Attribution
nodes.norm_label: stage d: ais correlation & vessel attribution

nodes.label: DataDisclosure
nodes.rationale: Carries synthetic-vs-real AIS nature in the payload itself, not asserted separately in a slide; currently always 'synthetic'.

nodes.label: PRD Claude Code Behavior Rules (16 items)
nodes.norm_label: prd claude code behavior rules (16 items)

nodes.label: PRD Contract Testing Requirement
nodes.rationale: Invalid Stage A payload must return clear validation error, e.g. 'Stage A response failed DetectionResult schema validation.'

nodes.label: PRD Coordinate System Contract
nodes.rationale: WGS84/EPSG:4326; {lat, lon} objects; GeoJSON [longitude, latitude]; never silently swap.

nodes.label: PRD Database Decision (No PostgreSQL for MVP)
nodes.norm_label: prd database decision (no postgresql for mvp)

nodes.label: PRD Definition of Done — Frontend (10 Judge Questions)
nodes.norm_label: prd definition of done — frontend (10 judge questions)

nodes.label: PRD Definition of Done — MVP Checklist
nodes.norm_label: prd definition of done — mvp checklist

nodes.label: PRD Error Handling Requirements
nodes.rationale: Stage D intentionally skipped is a valid state, not an error, e.g. 'Vessel attribution was not run because the source triage identified a likely pipeline source.'

nodes.label: PRD Explainability Principle
nodes.rationale: Every important result must have an evidence explanation, e.g. proximity, trajectory alignment, distance to pipeline/platform, time window.

nodes.label: PRD Final Product Positioning
nodes.rationale: 'An open, explainable decision-support platform...' Do not claim legal attribution, definitive vessel guilt, live AIS capability, calibrated probability unless implemented, or universal real-world accuracy.

nodes.label: PRD Final Priority Order (10 items)
nodes.rationale: Correctness > frozen contracts > end-to-end integration > Stage B correctness > Stage E completeness > frontend usability > explainability > testing > visual polish > worth-adding > stretch.

nodes.label: PRD First Claude Code Task (Audit Before Build)
nodes.norm_label: prd first claude code task (audit before build)

nodes.label: Demo Cases Provenance (OS-001/002/003)
nodes.rationale: All three cases use deterministic, hand-authored mock fixtures, never randomly generated. OS-001 is the required real historical spill but its coordinates/metadata are currently PROVISIONAL placeholders, not a real incident.

nodes.label: README Demo Cases Table
nodes.rationale: OS-001 likely-vessel Stage D runs; OS-002 likely-platform Stage D skipped; OS-003 likely-pipeline Stage D skipped — proves Stage B gates vessel attribution.

nodes.label: PRD Curated Demo First Principle
nodes.rationale: MVP frontend must use 2-3 curated pre-verified demo cases; at least one a real documented historical spill; arbitrary SAR upload is stretch, never the primary demo path.

nodes.label: PRD Mock Services Requirement
nodes.rationale: 3 mock cases (vessel/platform/pipeline) essential for demonstrating Stage B actually prevents force-fitting vessel attribution.

nodes.label: PRD Frontend Core Flow (8 Steps)
nodes.rationale: Landing -> Case Selection -> Detection -> Source Triage -> Origin/Drift -> Vessel Attribution -> Forecast -> Final Dossier.

nodes.label: PRD Frontend Product Philosophy
nodes.rationale: Guided investigation narrative, not a generic dashboard; progressively reveal evidence, avoid showing all information at once.

nodes.label: PRD Frontend Technology Choices
nodes.rationale: React, TypeScript, Vite, Mapbox GL JS, Tailwind, Framer Motion, Lucide React, Axios, Recharts if needed, Turf.js. Do NOT install Redux; do NOT install Zustand unless explicitly required.

nodes.label: PRD Development Boundary
nodes.rationale: Application must operate initially using mock implementations of Stages A, C, D so integration/frontend can proceed before teammates finish.

nodes.label: PRD Mapbox Requirements
nodes.rationale: MVP vessel points static; no animated tracks unless promoted to a later tier.

nodes.label: PRD Non-Accusatory Attribution Principle
nodes.rationale: System must never say 'Vessel X caused the spill'; say 'Vessel X is the highest-priority investigative lead.'

nodes.label: PRD Performance Requirement
nodes.rationale: FastAPI + in-memory/demo repository + file-based curated datasets preferred over microservices/Kubernetes/message queues/Redis/complex DBs.
